key.name: active-theme
key.description: The visual theme rendered onto the desktop background.

key.name: globe-enabled
key.description: Draw the globe onto the desktop background. Turning this off stops all background redrawing, which saves power; the transparent top bar and the translucent menus carry on working.

key.name: background-color
key.description: Colour of the sphere and the overlay drawn behind it.

key.name: background-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the background colour around the globe. 1.0 covers the desktop completely; 0.0, the default, leaves your wallpaper showing and lets the globe float over it.

key.name: globe-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the sphere itself. 1.0 is solid; 0.0 makes the globe see-through to the wallpaper.

key.name: panel-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the top bar background while the desktop is visible. 0.0 is fully transparent; 1.0 fills it with the background colour. The top bar is left to the shell's own theme in the overview and behind a maximized window.

key.name: menu-blur
key.description: Blur whatever is underneath the system menus, windows included. Renders nothing on drivers that cannot do background blur, in which case menus are simply translucent.

key.name: menu-blur-radius
key.description: How far the blur behind a menu reaches, in pixels. Only has any effect while blur behind menus is turned on.

key.name: menu-color
key.description: Colour laid over the blur in system menus, the app grid and the overview.

key.name: menu-opacity
key.description: How solid the menu colour is. 0.0 leaves only the blur showing; 1.0 hides the blur completely. Applies to menus only, never to the wallpaper behind the overview.

key.name: hover-color
key.description: Colour drawn behind app folders, search results and app grid icons, both at rest and while hovered or pressed.

key.name: hover-opacity
key.description: How solid that highlight is. 0.0 hides it entirely; 1.0 makes it opaque.

key.name: rotation-speed
key.description: Multiplier applied to the globe's base rotation speed.

key.name: fps
key.description: Maximum redraws per second. Lower values save power.

key.name: dock-enabled
key.description: Keep a dock on the desktop, outside the overview. It uses the same blur, tint and colour as the menus.

key.name: dock-autohide-portrait
key.description: On a monitor that is taller than it is wide, slide the dock away when a window on the active workspace would sit underneath it. Move the pointer to the bottom edge to bring it back.

key.name: dock-autohide-landscape
key.description: On a monitor that is wider than it is tall, slide the dock away when a window on the active workspace would sit underneath it. Move the pointer to the bottom edge to bring it back.

key.name: dock-radius
key.description: How rounded the dock's corners are, in pixels. 0 gives square corners.

key.name: dock-icon-size
key.description: Height of the dock's app icons, in pixels. The dock sizes itself around them.
